blocks.text: Ethene (C₂H₄) sab se saada alkene hai. Ethene ka har carbon atom sp² hybridized hai aur teen barabar sp² hybrid orbitals banata hai jo aik hi plane (satah) mein hote hain. Bacha hua unhybrid p-orbital in hybrid orbitals ke plane par perpendicular (90º, seedha khara) hota hai, jaisa Figure 11.8 mein hai.

Yeh sp² orbitals 2s orbital ko do 2p orbitals ke saath mila kar bante hain, aur aik p orbital unhybrid (bina mila) reh jata hai. Ethene mein har carbon apne do sp² orbitals se do C–H bonds banata hai. Har carbon ka teesra sp² orbital seedhe (linear) overlap se carbon-carbon σ bond banata hai, jaisa Figure 11.9 mein hai.

Dono carbon atoms ke unhybrid p-orbitals aik doosre ke parallel (mutawazi) hote hain aur pehlu se (laterally) overlap kar ke doosra carbon-carbon bond banate hain. p-orbitals ke pehlu se overlap se banne wale is bond ko π bond kehte hain.

blocks.title: Interesting Information!
blocks.text: Paude ethene ko qudrati pakane wale hormone ke taur par banate hain. Katai aur market tak le jane mein aasani ke liye phal aur sabziyan aksar kachi tor li jati hain aur phir ethene gas mein rakhi jati hain taake jaldi pak jayein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke is box mein likha hai ke phal ‘ethane’ mein rakhe jate hain. Pakane wala hormone ethene hai (box ka pehla jumla bhi yahi kehta hai), is liye sahi lafz ethene hai.

blocks.alt: x, y aur z axes par orbital khaaka. Teen naranji sp2 lobes xy plane mein, ek x ke saath; unhybrid p orbital ke do hare lobes z ke saath oopar neeche. Labels: Unhybrid p orbital, Hybrid sp2, The set of orbitals sp2 + p.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.8: Carbon ke sp2 hybrid aur unhybrid orbitals (kitab ki Figure 11.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Do carbons, har ek ka khara 2pz orbital (oopar neeche lobes); oopar aur neeche ki lakeerein 'pi-bond'. Carbons ke darmiyan do sp2 lobes seedha overlap karte hain (sigma-bond). Har carbon ke do aur sp2 lobes hare H atoms ke 1s orbitals se overlap karte hain (sigma-bonds).
blocks.caption: Figure 11.9: Ethene mein carbons ka bond banana (kitab ki Figure 11.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har carbon ke teen sp² orbitals aik hi plane mein hain: do orbitals H ke 1s se aur aik doosre carbon ke sp² se seedha (end-on) overlap kar ke sigma bonds banate hain. Bacha hua 2pz orbital plane par khara hai; dono carbons ke 2pz pehlu se (sideways) overlap kar ke plane ke oopar aur neeche π bond banate hain. Kitab ki figure mein H ke orbital ko ‘IS’ likha hai; sahi ‘1s’ hai.

blocks.alt: Halki chapti plane par ethene: do carbon C-C axis ke saath jamni sigma bond se jure, har carbon par do hydrogen naranji sigma bonds se taqreeban 120 degree par. Har carbon se hare 2p orbital lobes oopar neeche khare hain, aur plane ke oopar aur neeche do hare badal unhein jorte hain: yahi pi bond hai.
blocks.caption: Ethene mein sigma aur pi bonds: hamara apna 3D model (kitab ki Figure 11.9 oopar 2D khaake mein hai; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Ethene ka har carbon sp2 hai. Us ke teen sp2 orbitals aik plane mein 120 degree par hain aur end-on overlap se sigma bonds banate hain: aik C-C aur do C-H. Unhybridised 2p orbitals is plane par amudi (90 degree) khare hain aur plane ke oopar aur neeche pehlu ba pehlu (sideways) overlap kar ke pi bond banate hain. Pi bond molecule ko chapta rakhta hai aur C=C ke gird ghoomne nahi deta.

fallback.alt: 3D model ki tasveer: Ethene mein carbons ke darmiyan bond banna (sigma aur pi bonds).

blocks.text: Double bond banane wale do carbon atoms aur un se seedhe jure chaar atoms, sab aik hi plane mein hote hain. Har carbon ka bacha hua p-orbital π bond banane mein istemal hota hai.

sp² hybridization ki wajah se har carbon atom ke gird trigonal planar (teen konon wali chapti) tarteeb banti hai. Bond angles taqreeban 120º hote hain, is liye poora molecule chapta (planar) hota hai, jaisa Figure 11.10 mein hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethene molecule ki shape us ke C–C σ aur π bonds ki madad se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Har carbon apne 2s ko do 2p orbitals se mila kar aik plane mein 120º par teen sp² orbitals banata hai: do C–H bonds ke liye aur aik C–C σ bond ke liye. Bache hue p orbitals is plane par khare hain aur pehlu se overlap kar ke π bond banate hain. π bond ke liye p orbitals ka parallel rehna zaroori hai, is liye chhe ke chhe atoms aik plane mein rehte hain: chapta, trigonal planar molecule.

items: Ethene: har C sp² (2s + do 2p), teen hybrid orbitals 120º par aik plane mein, aik p orbital 90º par; C=C = σ (sp²–sp² seedha overlap) + π (p–p pehlu se overlap); planar molecule.
Ethene paudon ka pakane wala hormone hai.
